headline: Sapphiron in a guild-best 3:20, then a costly Kel'Thuzad kill

mvp.headline: 19 Life Drains removed on Sapphiron, then second on Kel'Thuzad
why: 19 Life Drains removed, the most, on the fastest Sapphiron the guild has

also.text: the most damage on Kel'Thuzad (238k) and 3 Frostbolts kicked

overview: The Sunday cleanup of Wednesday's lockout: Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad, both on the first pull. All 39 raiders came in with Rallying Cry, and Sapphiron fell in 3:20, the guild's fastest, with one death.
Kel'Thuzad took 3:44 and 25 lives. The Guardians killed at least five, mostly healers, a single Shadow Fissure killed four melee at 3:06, and his melee took several more in the last minute.
Warcraft Logs handed out no parses for either kill.

wentWell.text: Sapphiron in 3:20, a guild best, one death and 3 Blizzard hits all fight.
58 Life Drains removed: Eldoren 19, Osinir 11, Caesartje and Orbywan 10.

notes.text: 3:20, a guild best. Naturelocks died to Frost Aura at 1:47, the only death. Tochopolvo top at 175k, Yulefuel healed 207k.
3:44 (median 2:58), 25 deaths. Early ones: Eduard to Frost Blast at 1:01, Miniwrecker and Whorm to a Frostbolt volley at 1:03, Osinir at 1:27.

From 2:39 on the raid came apart: Guardians of Icecrown killed at least five, mostly healers (Yulefuel, Woness, Apoutchou, Sixto, Gallahan), a Shadow Fissure under the melee killed Selenax, Gertggs, Tochopolvo and Eïnherjar together at 3:06, and 12 deaths went to melee against a usual 4. 9 Shackles were cast.
